title: This very much is a show, not one of those photo op experiences! #imm...
transcript: I went to the immersive Great Gatsby that is currently playing in New York. This is one of 3 different Gatsby productions that we are getting over the next year. This is the first of them. And this Gatsby production is completely immersive. You walk through the Gatsby mansion, and you are LED into the main ballroom of the Gatsby mansion. This is where most of the story takes place. This is where the bar is. You can buy drinks before and during intermission. I somehow took absolutely no photos of this space. So here the official production stills. But this is where the main storyline primarily happens. Occasionally, however, depending on where you are standing in the room, characters will come around and pull a group of you into one of these smaller rooms in the mansion. And in these smaller rooms, you'll get more of the side plots of the Gatsby story. These rooms are incredibly detailed. It's almost like walking through a theme park. It's really, really cool. And occasionally you'll get pulled out of one of those rooms to an even more intimate experience, sometimes even one on one with one of the performers. And sometimes what you end up doing in those small rooms ends up affecting what happens in the main room. Just, you know, the little details that occur. Overall, I thought this experience was really cool. But I'm not super familiar with Great Gatsby. I never had to read it in school. I've Seen the movie literally once when it came out in theaters. I feel like every time I was pulled out of the main room, I kind of lost the plot of the story a little bit. So I would like to either listen to an audiobook or rewatch the film and then go back. The other thing I would do differently is I did not dress up for this, and I definitely felt underdressed. Get into character because it'll. It'll just enhance your experience. Also, the hotel that this experience is in has bag check, and I really wish I had ended up checking my bag. They had warned me ahead of time that I probably would want to, and ultimately I wish I did. I have just a small bag, but especially if you want to, like, get up and dance, it's hard to do that with a purse. If you want to drink during the experience, you can, but you cannot buy any drinks while the show is happening. So if you do, make sure to get the drinks either before or during intermission. Also, be aware, only go where you are asked to go. This is not a free range immersive experience. You can't just walk to whatever room you want to while it's happening. You will be invited to go places. We had one moment where too many people followed along to one of the performers, and they literally had to stall to try to figure Out how to get rid of some of the people that had tried to tag along, because the experience that we were going to had A capacity to it. So just be aware, don't try to just follow whoever you want. Overall, this was A ton of fun, and I definitely would want to do it again. To get some of the more of the story. And if you are A Gatsby fan, this is absolutely A must for you.
classificationReason: Creator attended the immersive Great Gatsby production in NYC and is sharing their first-hand experience and opinion about the show's staging, immersive elements, and production design
